name: Directus
description: The official Directus image with a Postgres database, its uploads on a lasting volume and an HTTPS address. Signs in with admin@example.com and the password shown to the team's owners and admins in the console; change the email in Directus after the first sign-in.

setup.command: p=$(cat); i=0; until wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8055/server/ping 2>/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -lt 150 ] || exit 3; sleep 2; done; d="node /directus/cli.js"; dp() { CP_PASSWORD="$p" node -e 'process.argv=[process.argv[0],"/directus/cli.js",...process.argv.slice(1),"--password",process.env.CP_PASSWORD];delete process.env.CP_PASSWORD;import("/directus/cli.js")' "$@"; }; if ! dp users passwd --email admin@example.com >/dev/null 2>&1; then r=$($d roles create --role Administrator --admin --app 2>/dev/null | grep -Eo "[0-9a-f-]{36}" | tail -n1); [ -n "$r" ] || exit 4; dp users create --email admin@example.com --role "$r" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 5; fi; touch /directus/uploads/.cloudploy-ready
